headline: CAD Operator
summary: Drafting technology graduate looking for a CAD operator role. I produce floor plans, elevations and details in AutoCAD from engineers' sketches, and I am quick and neat with layers, dimensions and title blocks. I want to join a design or construction firm and keep learning.

experience.title: Drafting Intern
bullets: Drafted floor plans and elevations for four residential projects from the architect's sketches.
Cleaned up and standardised layers and title blocks on older drawing files.
